data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to offer you this spacious apartment in The Address Jumeirah Resort and Spa.

Features:
⦁ Ensuite in all 3 bedrooms
⦁ Full sea view from all the rooms
⦁ Maid's room
⦁ Fully Furnished
⦁ Floor to ceiling windows making the apartment bright & airy.
⦁ Direct beach access.
⦁ Brand New.
⦁ 24 Hrs security & concierge service.
⦁ Balconies overlooking JBR, Bluewater's Island, Ain Dubai (Dubai Eye), Palm Jumeirah & Burj Al Arab.
⦁ Pool & Gym within the building.

Hotel Facilities:
⦁ Health club & Pools.
⦁ World-class hotel amenities.
⦁ Restaurants and bars.

Why the address JBR?

Live the Luxury Lifestyle, directly on the beach in one of most luxurious new hotels in Dubai - The Address JBR Marina. Six Restaurants, Exclusive Rooftop Infinity Pool, Beach Club with direct Private Beach access and Multiple Pool/Lounge areas. Super Modern Top Floor Gymnasium with Views overlooking Sea and City Skyline.

Full Fitness Class Timetable offering Classes both Indoor and Outdoor (on the beach). 24 hour Room Service and Security
